title: BSU hosted a seminar on writing articles and publishing in the Scopus database

blocks.text: On April 4, 2025, a seminar on writing scientific articles and publishing them in the international Scopus database was held at Bishkek State University named after K. Karasaev.

The seminar for the faculty was conducted by Asel Shaiyldaeva, head of the department of scientific and metric analysis of the Kyrgyz National University named after J. Balasagyn, and the leading specialist of the department, Umut Zholdoshali kyzy.

During the event, the requirements for writing articles for the Scopus database, the structure of a scientific article, reference design, choosing a suitable journal, and ways to get international publications were examined in detail. Participants received answers to questions of interest and practical recommendations.
